headline: Binance Hacker Dumps FUN and Smaller Tokens, Triggering 90% Price Crash
summary: A hacker dumped FUN and other low-capitalization tokens into markets with insufficient liquidity to absorb the large sell orders, causing prices to collapse by 90%.
why: Thin order books in low-cap cryptocurrency tokens make them highly vulnerable to sharp price collapses when large volumes are liquidated unexpectedly.

impacts.name: FUNToken
impacts.why: Heavy selling by a hacker into illiquid order books caused the token's price to drop 90%.
